from netnomos.finite import compile_job
from reference import ref_compile

cases = []

# A: duplicate train rows, extreme domain values, zero spelling, leading zeros
cases.append({'fields':[{'name':'x','type':'id','domain':[0,1000000]}],'slots':1,
 'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':'id'}},
               {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1000000,'type':'id'}}],
 'width':2,'train':[[[0]],[[0]]],
 'approved':[[0],[1],[0,1]],
 'queries':[{'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'0','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'00','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'1000000','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'1','fixed':[]}]})
# same but no approvals -> empty theory decoding
cases.append({'fields':[{'name':'x','type':'id','domain':[0,1000000]}],'slots':1,
 'predicates':[{'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':0,'type':'id'}},
               {'kind':'cmp','left':{'ref':[0,'x']},'op':'eq','right':{'const':1000000,'type':'id'}}],
 'width':2,'train':[[[0]],[[0]]],'approved':[],

            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'1','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[0,'x'],'prefix':'','fixed':[{'ref':[0,'x'],'value':1000000}]}]})
# B: any/all over 3 slots
cases.append({'fields':[{'name':'a','type':'count','domain':[0,1,2]}],'slots':3,
 'predicates':[{'kind':'any','field':'a','op':'eq','value':2},
               {'kind':'all','field':'a','op':'le','value':1}],
 'width':2,'train':[[[[0]],[[1]],[[2]]]] if False else [[[0]],[[1]],[[2]]],
 'approved':[[0]],
 'queries':[{'target':[0,'a'],'prefix':'','fixed':[]},
            {'target':[2,'a'],'prefix':'2','fixed':[{'ref':[0,'a'],'value':0},{'ref':[1,'a'],'value':1}]},
            {'target':[2,'a'],'prefix':'','fixed':[{'ref':[0,'a'],'value':2}]}]})
# C: semantically equal predicates with distinct IDs
cases.append({'fields':[{'name':'x','type':'size','domain':[5,7]}],'slots':1,

# D: constant predicates and scaled/summed terms
cases.append({'fields':[{'name':'p','type':'time','domain':[1,2]},{'name':'q','type':'time','domain':[3,4]}],'slots':2,
